dz: 加泰罗尼亚法院最后一届历史会议加泰罗尼亚公国议会结束. 法院通过的加泰罗尼亚宪法现代化,旨在改善对个人,政治和经济权利的保障(如通信保密等).
de: The last session of history of the Catalan Courts, the parliament of the Principality of Catalonia, ends. Catalonia's constitutional modernisation passed by the Courts aims to improve the guarantee of individual, political and economic rights (such as the secrecy of correspondence).

de: John Churchill, 1st Duke of Marlborough, defeats a French army under Marshal François de Neufville, duc de Villeroy at the Battle of Ramillies.

dz: 1707年联邦法案由英格兰王国和苏格兰王国的委员们商定,在得到各国议会通过后,导致建立大不列颠王国.
de: The Acts of Union 1707 are agreed upon by commissioners from the Kingdom of England and the Kingdom of Scotland, which, when passed by each country's Parliament, leads to the creation of the Kingdom of Great Britain.
